name: 8fold/php-architecture
description: Shared domain attributes, PHPStan static analysis purity rules, and GitHub Copilot instruction contracts for 8fold PHP applications.

scripts.graph:refresh: if [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/graphify" ] && [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ]; then GRAPHIFY_NO_BACKUP=1 "$HOME/.local/bin/graphify" update . && php cli/graphify-token-usage.php --measured 0 0; else echo 'graphify or graphify-out/graph.json not found; skipping graph refresh'; fi

scripts-descriptions.production: Runs autoloader optimization, full QA check suite, and builds production assets.
scripts-descriptions.local: Prepares dev environment (git hooks & build; optional: [email] [graph] [no-build]).
scripts-descriptions.check: Runs full QA sweep: PHP CodeSniffer, PHPStan static analysis, and all test suites.
scripts-descriptions.check:style: Runs PHP CodeSniffer style compliance checks.
scripts-descriptions.graph:refresh: Updates the Graphify codebase knowledge graph and logs token usage.
scripts-descriptions.optimize-autoloader: Dumps authoritative classmap autoloader excluding dev dependencies.
